blocks.text: A valid attention edge must satisfy document equality and causal order at the same time. The task is: Create a causal attention permission mask for packed documents. A token may attend to itself or earlier tokens from the same document only. IDs uniquely identify packed documents.

The inputs are `document_ids`. Keep their roles separate while you trace the solution. The animation follows the supplied implementation, so every highlighted operation connects to code you can inspect.
